What guests mention

What guests mention most

From the photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Kleftiko and lamb shank

11 Google reviews mention the lamb shank and 8 the kleftiko. One guest writes that the kleftiko pie was delicious and everything tasted homemade and authentic.

Sunday roast and lemon pie

12 reviews mention the Sunday roast, 6 the lemon pie and 4 the pork chop. One guest writes that the chocolate cake was huge and very moist.

Local food, sunset view

30 reviews mention the local food, 18 Cypriot cooking and 10 the sunset view. Guests write about generous portions and reasonable prices.

From the kitchen

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Welcomed like family

One guest writes that the staff were so welcoming and friendly, full of love just like family members, another calls them the kindest people.

Bread and dip to start

One guest writes about a complimentary starter of bread with dip, an amazing tuna salad and hearty, filling meat and potato dishes.

Cosy, Greek music, no TV

One guest describes the place as cosy, clean and pleasant, with Greek background music and no TV showing sports, and writes that parking is easy.
